mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor), 0) FROM refunds WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('COMPLETED', 'PENDING')
SELECT id, provider_refund_id, amount_minor, currency, status FROM refunds WHERE idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refunds (id, order_id, provider_refund_id, amount_minor, currency, status, reason, idempotency_key, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{orderId}, #{providerRefundId}, #{amountMinor}, #{currency}, #{status}, #{reason}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
